profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Cologix facility is part of the company Ashburn, Virginia or Silicon Valley, California footprint. Cologix own site states the company has been operational since December 2010 and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado, describing itself as North America leading network neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company, with 45 plus facilities across 13 North American markets serving about 2,000 customers with access to 725 plus networks and 350 plus cloud service providers. Confirmed United States markets include Ashburn, Virginia; Columbus, Ohio; Dallas, Texas; Des Moines, Iowa; Jacksonville and Lakeland, Florida; Minneapolis, Minnesota; New Jersey; and Silicon Valley, California, where the company SV1 facility was acquired from vXchnge in 2021. Cologix grew through a series of acquisitions beginning in 2010, including Navisite, The Minnesota Gateway, Canix, MetroOptic in 2019, vXchnge in 2020 to 2021, and Cyxtera in 2023, the last of which connects to the separate Cyxtera operator record elsewhere in this registry. No building specific address or individual MW figures for this particular registry row were located in available sourcing this session.

reading.body:
Cologix ASH2 in Ashburn, Virginia is a 51 MW IT capacity data center across two addresses in a market that has published figures for only 23 of its 326 mapped facilities. This campus ranks ninth among Virginia's published capacity and represents 3.7 percent of the state's disclosed 1,375 MW total. The operator is network-neutral, meaning the campus qualifies to host multiple tenants across different service providers rather than serving a single customer.

At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 51 MW of IT load translates to roughly 1,275 racks. At 6 kW per GPU in large-scale training clusters, this would support approximately 8,500 high-end accelerators. Whether ASH2 operates at these densities is not published. The facility was not confirmed to house AI workloads specifically; network-neutral colocation serves hyperscale, cloud, and enterprise tenants across use cases.

The campus sits in Northern Virginia's Ashburn cluster, a zone of extreme datacenter density fed by multiple fiber routes but not yet known to this site as constrained by local power. Published power capacity alone does not indicate whether ASH2 has access to sufficient grid allocation to run at nameplate, or whether expansion is grid-limited in practice. Neither the operator's current utilization nor specific power interconnection agreements are published.
